audit.whatIsWrong: The page had Aurora's kit mapped to the wrong slots throughout. It calls E 'her E dash' and treats it as a gap-closer six times — The Weirding is a blast that slows and then hops her BACKWARD to safety, i.e. a disengage. Her leap and invisibility are Across the Veil (W), which the page called '(Hop)' but never described. It invents 'Between Worlds passive stacks' and a 'passive stack threshold' — Between Worlds is her ultimate, and the passive is Spirit Abjuration, which heals her off exorcised spirits and has no threshold at all. Twofold Hex's recast, which drags the curse back through you and is most of her lane damage, is never mentioned; nor is the fact that at 900 range it outranges your 850 Avengerang.
audit.why: Riot text: P 'Exorcised spirits follow Aurora around and heal her'; Q 'recast the ability to draw active curses back toward herself'; W 'leaps in a direction... entering the spirit realm upon landing, becoming invisible'; E 'damages and slows enemies before Aurora hops backward to safety'; R 'Between Worlds... creates an area that slows enemies within it and allows Aurora to teleport from one side of the area to the other'.
audit.corrected: whys[1..6], spikes[0..3], early, mid, late, breakdown.cooldowns, report[5].t, enemyWin, the do/don't bodies, tradeGood, tradeBad, ahead, breakdown.carry and all three wants.foe entries rewritten on the real kit.

notes: The central error on this page was a slot swap repeated in six places: 'her E dash' as a gap-closer. The Weirding (E) hops her BACKWARD after the blast — it is a disengage, and treating it as an engage tells the reader to expect her to come to him. Her leap and invisibility are Across the Veil (W), 22s at rank 1, and that cooldown is the only real green light in this lane. 'Between Worlds passive stacks' and the 'passive stack threshold' were invented outright; Spirit Abjuration is a heal, which also makes this a Grievous Wounds matchup that the page never mentioned. One thing I could not verify and did not write: whether Akshan's Going Rogue camouflage and Aurora's spirit-realm invisibility interact in any way (does either reveal the other), so no claim is made in either direction.
